ONE HIGH bug found: dashboard-referral-nudge is only rendered inside the cards.length>0 branch of Home.jsx (line 74+ ternary) — fresh owners with 0 cards see home-empty state and NO nudge, even if they have qualified referrals. Both OWNER_A (0 qualified, 0 cards) and OWNER_B (5 qualified, 0 cards) confirmed nudge absent. This blocks the entire dashboard nudge feature for the most important audience (new owners who most need referrals) and also for owners currently between cards.

ui_bugs.issue: dashboard-referral-nudge is placed inside the `cards.length > 0` render branch (Home.jsx line ~110), so any owner with 0 cards — including all freshly-registered trial accounts and owners who deleted their card — never sees the referral nudge on /dashboard. Reproduced with OWNER_A (0 qualified, 0 cards) and OWNER_B (5 qualified, 0 cards): both show data-testid='home-empty' and no dashboard-referral-nudge selector. Fix: move <ReferralNudge /> above the ternary (or into a shared header inside the empty branch too) so it renders unconditionally for any owner with a workspace. This is important because the nudge's whole purpose is to prompt new owners to invite friends and this is the state that most needs it.

The 'LIVE PREVIEW' phone mockup on /templates shows action labels 'EXCHANGE CONTACT', 'SEND A MESSAGE', 'SAVE', 'SHARE', 'QR', 'Apple Wallet', 'Google Wallet' hardcoded in English even when locale is 'es' or 'ar'. The main industry sample cards in the left panel ARE localized correctly (Intercambiar contacto / تبادل جهة الاتصال) — this only affects the right-hand live-preview card, which is out of scope for the phase-2 story but worth noting.

action_items: HIGH: Move <ReferralNudge /> in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx OUTSIDE the `cards.length > 0` conditional (currently around line 110). Recommended: render it right after the welcome heading (around line 65) so it appears for empty-state (0 cards) and populated dashboards alike. Ensures data-testid='dashboard-referral-nudge' is present for every logged-in owner.

LOW/OPTIONAL: Localize the LIVE PREVIEW phone mockup CTA labels on /templates (Exchange Contact, Send a Message, Save, Share, QR, Apple/Google Wallet). Not part of the phase-2 requirement but stands out visually alongside the fully-localized industry sample cards.
critical_code_review_comments: platform_v1.py at 2247 lines — still growing. Carrying recommendation to extract referrals/billing/gdpr into modules; the new record_paid_subscription_event + revoke_referral_qualification pair is a clean seam to split on.

record_paid_subscription_event correctly dedups by billing_events.key (unique index) with key = event_id or f'{source}:{ws_id}'. For a future Stripe integration, note that using event_id verbatim means Stripe webhook retries with the same event id are safely idempotent; and demo replays for the same ws_id are also safely deduped. Good.
_qualify_referral has both a pre-check `r.get('status') == 'qualified'` early return AND an atomic conditional update `{'status':{'$ne':'qualified'}}` — double-guarded, race-safe. Good.

_recompute_referral_rewards uses `voided:{$ne:True}` in the `existing` count so future revocations reduce earned correctly (when combined with revoke_referral_qualification which void-flags the highest unredeemed grant). Sensible policy.
revoke_referral_qualification is defined but NOT wired to any endpoint or webhook yet (docstring correctly says 'FUTURE'). Should stay uncalled until refund policy is defined.

ReferralNudge.jsx correctly reads d.config.referrals_per_reward and passes {count: per} — no hardcoded 5. Message flip between nudgeStart/nudgeProgress/nudgeUnlocked is logical. Only defect is the mount location in Home.jsx (see HIGH bug).

Referral.jsx celebration guard uses parseInt(localStorage 'tp_referral_earned_seen' || '0'). Persisting after every fetch means once seen it stays seen — good. Edge case: if free_months_earned decreases (via revocation), earned<seen so no celebration; localStorage is then overwritten to the lower value, so a subsequent re-earn (back up to old level) will NOT re-trigger. Deliberate but worth documenting.
IndustryCard.jsx uses t(`industries.${c.id}.role`, c.role) with the c.role English fallback — good defensive default that survives missing translations.

Backend: SUPER_ADMIN gets 404 on /referral (no workspace membership) — this is intentional but the frontend RewardCelebration triggers off a Referral page fetch; SUPER_ADMIN opening /referral will see the empty error state, which is fine but the auto-navigation from the dashboard nudge should be gated so SUPER_ADMIN never sees the nudge (currently ReferralNudge silently returns null on API error, so this is already safe).

rca of the issue: Home.jsx renders <ReferralNudge /> only within the `cards.length > 0` branch of the top-level ternary (see /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx around line 74 → 110). Any fresh trial account has 0 cards → falls into the `home-empty` branch (line 68-72) which does NOT include ReferralNudge, so the nudge component is never mounted, GET /referral is never fired, and the data-testid never appears in the DOM. Reproduce: register a fresh account (POST /api/auth/register), navigate /dashboard, inspect — no dashboard-referral-nudge selector. Fix: hoist <ReferralNudge /> above the ternary (e.g. immediately after the welcome heading around line 64) so it renders for every authenticated owner regardless of card count. Do not remove the existing instance inside the populated branch — either move it out entirely OR duplicate it into the empty branch too. Simpler: hoist it once.
